searchText: Fuzzyvm just creates tests, you can run them using goevmlab/cmd/runtests eof call in 5 minutes: https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/85004720429?pwd=K1hnV1Z4bE1RZW50VEZTQnlCNHNuUT09 agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/753 A comment about gas observability: current instruction `GAS` reveals information about both gas usage and gas limit. We can redesign the system to only reveal information about gas usage: `GASUSED` gets the amount of gas used since the beginning of a transaction.
